title: SPLA/154/2019 of SHAILESH KUMAR RAI Vs HARPREET KAUR AISHPUJANI

paras.text:
SPLA 154/2019
With
CRLA 428/2019
Hon'ble N.S. Dhanik, J.
Mr. D.N. Sharma, Advocate, for the
applicant/appellant.
None appears for the respondent
despite sufficient service.
Leave is granted.
SPLA 154/2019 stands allowed
accordingly.
Appeal is admitted for hearing.
Summon the LCR.
Let fresh steps for service on the
respondent be taken within ten days.
List after service report is received.
 (N.S. Dhanik, J.)
 1.12.2020
